svg.title: meander-greek-key bore - section 1 of 1, sheet 2 of 2, bend DDDDDDDDDDLLLLLLLLLUUUUUURRRRRDDLLLDDRRRRRUUUUUULLLLLLLLLDDDDDDDDDD~a~b, 11 parts on 540x92mm
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. 10mm square bore in 3mm stock, cut for a 3mm sheet at 0.15mm kerf, so a 16mm block pitch; a block that runs straight is 16mm long and a block that turns is a 16mm cube. Blocks 1-68 of the walk, entering on N and leaving on N, a 12x13 block plate laid flat. Two face plates (mirror images) and the side walls; one section, so nothing is engraved - every part would carry the same number and the plate is the jig. Inner cuts are the port and come before their outline. black #000000 cuts; there is no engrave stage on this sheet.
